name: Ayça Bingöl
bio:
Ayça Bingöl (January 16, 1975, Istanbul). is a Turkish actress, recognized for her roles in the Storm of Passions series, Babam ve Ailesi, having made multiple commercials in Turkey, and is a voice actress for several well-known films.

She is married to Producer Ali Altuğ with whom she has two daughters, the twins Aylin and Leyla. Bingöl, started as a professional actress at the Dormen Theater in 1996 and played at Theater Fora as a guest actress between 1998-2000. Bingöl, who plays a role in commercials, films and serials, and also as a voice actress, was found on the Yeditepe Players team. In the 2007-2008 season he participated in the Duru Theater group with a play called Picasso Gerek. During the 2008-2009 season, he starred in the Nehru Pale Face in Theater Studio.
